title: Mordheim KB catalogue — Dramatis Personae profiles of catalog/hirelings/dramatis-personae
description: The canonical identity of a Dramatis Persona, the named special characters a campaign can hire. Same ownership rule as the Hired Swords: this file holds what belongs to the character, while `catalog/campaign/hired-swords-and-dramatis.yaml` holds the campaign-side contract and points back here through `profile_id`. Unlike a Hired Sword, a Dramatis Persona may be published while it cannot be modelled yet: the entry then declares `normalization_status: out_of_scope` and says why, and it is excluded from the hiring catalogue.

catalog.description: Catalogue id shared by every grade file of the family: `hirelings-dramatis-personae`.

grade.description: Grade of the file, mirroring the hiring grades of the campaign catalogue.

rules.description: The rules of the profiles of the core file. The core Dramatis declare their rules here, with `source_refs`, and their profiles point at them with `rule_ids`; the other grades keep the rules inline in the profile instead.

catalog_rule.description: A rule declared by the document itself and referenced by a profile's `rule_ids`.

profile.description: One Dramatis Persona. Characteristics and equipment may be absent while the entry is out of scope, but the identity, the publication and the source stay declared: a published entry is never anonymous.

grade.description: Grade of the profile; it repeats the file's grade so a record keeps its source when moved.

publication.description: Publication the character was printed in, e.g. `Town Cryer 21, Khemri`.

warband_rating.description: The rating the character contributes: a fixed value, or a base plus one point per accumulated Experience point.

skill_access.description: Skill lists the character may learn from.

starting_skill_ids.description: Canonical skill ids the character starts with. Empty when the source declares none.

rules.description: The intrinsic special rules, inline: text that belongs to this character and is not shared.

rule_ids.description: Ids of rules that live in `dramatis-personae/rules.yaml` or in this file.

unresolved_references.description: Source concepts this character uses whose canonical catalogue does not exist yet. Never given a guessed canonical id. An empty list is the declared convention for `nothing pending`.

normalization_status.description: `normalized` for a character that could be modelled; `out_of_scope` for one that is published but cannot be represented yet, which then must declare `out_of_scope_reason` and is excluded from the hiring catalogue.

out_of_scope_reason.description: Why the character cannot be modelled yet: a composite entity, a random profile, several selectable personas. Required exactly when `normalization_status` is `out_of_scope`.

kind.description: `fixed` for a flat contribution; `base_plus_experience` for a base amount plus one point per Experience point.

per_experience_point.description: Points added per accumulated Experience point, when `kind` is `base_plus_experience`.

equipment.description: Intrinsic equipment of a Dramatis Persona: canonical items, plus the equipment that exists only on this character.

unique_equipment.description: Equipment that exists only on this character: named here with its own rules instead of being invented as a catalogue item.

fixed_item.description: A canonical item with the quantity the character carries.

notes.description: Editorial note on the reference, not on the item: how the source's wording resolves to this canonical id, or what the printed entry says about carrying it. The same field the band equipment lists carry on their entries.

unique_equipment.description: A piece of equipment that exists only on this character. Its id follows the profile (`hireling.dramatis.<slug>.item.<slug>`).

counts_as.description: Canonical item this equipment counts as, either named plainly or with the context in which it counts as it.

save.description: Save the equipment grants, as printed: `4+`, or `4+ unmodifiable` when the source forbids modifiers.

rules.description: Ids of the rules of this same profile that describe the equipment.

counts_as.description: Canonical item this unique equipment counts as, in a named context.

context.description: Where it counts as that item: `rules` or `close_combat`.

inline_rule.description: A rule that belongs to one character. Its id follows the profile (`hireling.dramatis.<slug>.rule.<slug>`).

kind.description: Optional editorial classification of the rule.

mechanics.description: Optional typed mechanics the rule declares.

unresolved_reference.description: A source concept with no canonical catalogue yet.

source_name.description: The wording of the source, kept verbatim.

note.description: Why it is unresolved, when the source wording alone does not say.
